prompt:
Paint ONE building for a top-down pixel-art JRPG town map, in the classic 3/4 top-down RPG view: the roof is seen from above (it fills the upper coloured block of the guide) and the front wall is seen straight on (the lower block). The attached image is an exact layout guide drawn at the final proportions: keep the outer silhouette, the roof/wall split line, the door (dark brown rectangle: it must stay exactly there, same size, at ground level, a real door you can walk through) and the windows (yellow rectangles) in exactly the same places. You may add small details (eaves, trim, drainpipe, flower boxes, crates by the wall, a chimney poking above the roof into the empty top margin).
This building: a one-storey house in a forest village built among giant trees (rustic log houses, carved wood, lanterns). thick golden-brown straw thatch roof walls of stacked round logs with notched corners. Windows have small panes glowing warm amber from inside (the only light). Flower boxes under some windows. The whole image is 208 x 160 art pixels (each art pixel 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent (the magenta in the guide is background). No ground, no shadow, no people, no text, no letters.
revised_prompt: Edit the attached layout-guide image into ONE standalone forest-village JRPG house sprite. Treat the guide as a strict pixel-coordinate mask and preserve its proportions and placements: canvas 1456×1120 corresponds to 208×160 art pixels at exactly 7×7 display pixels per art pixel. The magenta outside the building MUST become alpha-transparent, not magenta. Roof silhouette exactly x=14..1442, y=196..714; roof/wall dividing line exactly y=423..437; exposed front wall x=56..1400, y=715..1119. Preserve the two yellow window rectangles in exactly their current positions, sizes and the dark brown door rectangle in exactly its current position, size and reaching the bottom at ground level; add small crisp wooden mullions inside windows and retain their warmly glowing amber panes. Door remains a functional dark-brown walk-through door, not a window. Paint thick golden-brown straw thatch over the large upper roof block, roof viewed from above, tidy layered straw bundles in chunky pixel clusters and strong eave at the existing split line. Paint front wall as horizontal stacked round rustic logs with notched corners, carved wooden frames around existing openings and modest flower boxes under the windows. Optional small wood chimney in empty upper margin. Classic 3/4 top-down RPG town-map sprite with roof seen from above and flat front elevation seen straight on; no visible side face, no ground. Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art, strictly crisp square uniform 7×7 source pixels, hand-placed block clusters, no antialiasing, blur, texture noise, gradients or dithering. Earthy rich palette 4–6 shades per material, saturated reddish-purple shadows and warm golden highlights. Neutral even overcast lighting upper left; only windows glow, without any outside light pools. No shadows outside building, no text, characters, or scenery. Preserve guide geometry above all else.
